svg.title: CSEM co-training architecture
svg.desc: An encoder maps an image to a diagonal Gaussian posterior with mean mu and covariance Sigma; a sampled latent z0 is decoded to a reconstruction. The latent is noised along an OU process and a DiT score network with a factored precision/mean head predicts the noise. The training target is the analytic CSEM target computed from the encoder's mean and covariance, so the CSEM loss sends gradients back into the encoder for diffusion times below T_K.
